pattern_summary: Small processor-side amount differences of one to five cents with matching currency, merchant, and reference.
root_cause: Known processor fee or rounding behavior.
successful_action: Evaluate a bounded amount_tolerance_cents up to 5, backtest before promotion.

pattern_summary: Same amount and reference but settlement date arrives one day later.
successful_action: Evaluate date_tolerance_days=1 while requiring strong reference and amount agreement.

pattern_summary: Reference IDs differ only by punctuation, case, or a processor suffix.
successful_action: Normalize case, punctuation, and known suffixes before comparison.

pattern_summary: Large amount differences or currency mismatch despite a similar identifier.
root_cause: Potential true mismatch; unsafe to auto-reconcile.
successful_action: Escalate and preserve as unmatched. Never widen tolerance enough to absorb large differences or currency changes.
